name: Math Agent
description: Answers arithmetic and short word-math problems via Llama 3.3 (Groq) in JSON mode. Returns a deterministic JSON envelope so clients can extract the numeric answer programmatically.

skills.name: Answer a math question
skills.description: Accepts an arithmetic expression or a short word problem; returns a JSON object with `answer` (number or null) and `explanation` (one-sentence rationale).
